scope: Apply role-specific concise-message contracts and sentence-preserving bounds in the local consultation coordinator. No GoDaddy application, database, migration, reset, deletion, deployment or external upload was contacted.

checks.name: deterministic concise-message bounds
checks.observed: A long provider message is committed for one specialist, Critic, specialist revision and final Head synthesis only after each role-specific maximum is applied at a completed sentence.
checks.limit: The controlled seam cannot establish that every provider response is decision-useful.

checks.name: real local provider discussion
checks.evidence: isolated local HTTP consultation through the actual local Codex app-server
checks.observed: A one-specialist, one-exchange consultation completed in this order: Head Consultant -> Strategy Consultant task (338 characters); Strategy Consultant -> Critic position (1265); Critic -> Strategy Consultant challenge (655); Strategy Consultant -> Critic revision (1028); Head Consultant -> owner synthesis (1474). The specialist proposed a narrowly scoped paid pilot; Critic challenged causal attribution; the specialist tightened the evidence threshold before the final synthesis. All visible messages stayed within their configured bounds and the Head gave no owner-facing opinion before the final synthesis.
checks.limit: One synthetic local question does not establish answer quality for every topic, live deployment, GoDaddy hosting or formal release QA.

checks.name: regression suite
checks.observed: 38 Node tests passed, including the authenticated two-specialist HTTP discussion and the new sentence-bound test.
checks.limit: The suite does not replace the prepared release QA and DoD gates.
